function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}
const body = $json.body || $json;
const avatar = String(body.avatar || '').trim();
const scene = String(body.scene || '').trim();
const includePublished = body.includePublished === true || body.include_published === true;
const requestedLimit = Number(body.limit || 30);
const limit = Number.isFinite(requestedLimit) ? Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(requestedLimit), 1), 100) : 30;
const where = [];
if (avatar) where.push('avatar = ' + sql(avatar));
if (scene) where.push('scene = ' + sql(scene));
if (!includePublished) where.push("status <> 'published'");
const whereSql = where.length ? 'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '';
const query = `
WITH selected_jobs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM publication_jobs
  ${whereSql}
  ORDER BY
    CASE status
      WHEN 'failed' THEN 0
      WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN 1
      WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN 2
      WHEN 'assets-ready' THEN 3
      WHEN 'review-ready' THEN 4
      WHEN 'generating' THEN 5
      WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN 6
      WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN 7
      WHEN 'draft' THEN 8
      ELSE 9
    END,
    updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    created_at DESC
  LIMIT ${limit}
), job_actions AS (
  SELECT
    sj.publication_job_id,
    sj.avatar,
    sj.scene,
    sj.format,
    sj.objective,
    sj.business_profile,
    sj.asset_type,
    sj.status,
    sj.error_message,
    sj.created_at,
    sj.updated_at,
    sj.metadata,
    latest_asset.asset_id AS latest_asset_id,
    latest_asset.bucket AS latest_asset_bucket,
    latest_asset.object_path AS latest_asset_object_path,
    latest_asset.status AS latest_asset_status,
    latest_asset.metadata AS latest_asset_metadata,
    selected_asset.asset_id AS selected_asset_id,
    selected_asset.bucket AS selected_asset_bucket,
    selected_asset.object_path AS selected_asset_object_path,
    selected_asset.status AS selected_asset_status,
    CASE sj.status
      WHEN 'draft' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-brief', 'label', 'Generate brief', 'description', 'Generate or paste the creative brief for this publication.')
      WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-prompt-pack', 'label', 'Generate prompt pack', 'description', 'Create the Comfy-ready prompt pack from the approved brief.')
      WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-images', 'label', 'Generate images', 'description', 'Submit the prompt pack to Comfy Cloud.')
      WHEN 'generating' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'ingest-output', 'label', 'Ingest Comfy output', 'description', 'Wait for the generated image, then paste the Comfy output URL.')
      WHEN 'review-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'select-asset', 'label', 'Select publication asset', 'description', 'Review the generated image and select it for this publication job.')
      WHEN 'assets-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-copy-pack', 'label', 'Generate copy', 'description', 'Generate or edit the caption and publishing copy.')
      WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'export-pack', 'label', 'Export publishing pack', 'description', 'Prepare the image URL, caption, hashtags, and manual publishing instructions.')
      WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'publish-manually', 'label', 'Publish manually and record URL', 'description', 'Post from Instagram, then mark the job as published.')
      WHEN 'published' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'complete', 'label', 'Complete', 'description', 'This publication has been recorded as published.')
      WHEN 'failed' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'review-error', 'label', 'Review error', 'description', 'Read the error, fix the cause, and retry the failed step.')
      ELSE jsonb_build_object('action', 'inspect-status', 'label', 'Inspect status', 'description', 'Review the job status and continue from the matching section.')
    END AS next_action
  FROM selected_jobs sj
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT car.*
    FROM canonical_asset_registry car
    WHERE car.asset_id::text = sj.metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetId'
       OR (car.metadata->>'publicationJobId' = sj.publication_job_id::text AND car.asset_type = sj.asset_type)
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN car.asset_id::text = sj.metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetId' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      car.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest_asset ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT car.*
    FROM canonical_asset_registry car
    WHERE car.asset_id::text = sj.metadata->>'selectedAssetId'
    LIMIT 1
  ) selected_asset ON true
), job_rows AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'publicationJobId', publication_job_id,
    'avatar', avatar,
    'scene', scene,
    'format', format,
    'objective', objective,
    'businessProfile', business_profile,
    'status', status,
    'createdAt', created_at,
    'updatedAt', updated_at,
    'errorMessage', error_message,
    'generationJobId', metadata->>'generationJobId',
    'latestAssetId', COALESCE(latest_asset_id::text, metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetId'),
    'latestAssetBucket', latest_asset_bucket,
    'latestAssetObjectPath', COALESCE(latest_asset_object_path, metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetObjectPath'),
    'latestAssetStatus', latest_asset_status,
    'latestAssetQa', COALESCE(latest_asset_metadata->'qa', metadata->'latestGeneratedAssetQa'),
    'latestAssetDefective', CASE
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(latest_asset_metadata->>'defective', metadata->>'latestGeneratedAssetDefective', 'false')) IN ('true', 't', '1', 'yes') THEN true
      ELSE false
    END,
    'latestAssetDefectReasons', COALESCE(latest_asset_metadata->'defectReasons', metadata->'latestGeneratedAssetDefectReasons', '[]'::jsonb),
    'latestAssetUrl', CASE
      WHEN latest_asset_bucket IS NOT NULL AND latest_asset_object_path IS NOT NULL THEN '/minio/' || latest_asset_bucket || '/' || latest_asset_object_path
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'selectedAssetId', COALESCE(selected_asset_id::text, metadata->>'selectedAssetId'),
    'selectedAssetBucket', COALESCE(selected_asset_bucket, metadata->>'selectedAssetBucket'),
    'selectedAssetObjectPath', COALESCE(selected_asset_object_path, metadata->>'selectedAssetObjectPath'),
    'selectedAssetStatus', selected_asset_status,
    'selectedAssetUrl', CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(selected_asset_bucket, metadata->>'selectedAssetBucket') IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(selected_asset_object_path, metadata->>'selectedAssetObjectPath') IS NOT NULL
      THEN '/minio/' || COALESCE(selected_asset_bucket, metadata->>'selectedAssetBucket') || '/' || COALESCE(selected_asset_object_path, metadata->>'selectedAssetObjectPath')
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'thumbnailUrl', COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(selected_asset_bucket, metadata->>'selectedAssetBucket') IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(selected_asset_object_path, metadata->>'selectedAssetObjectPath') IS NOT NULL
        THEN '/minio/' || COALESCE(selected_asset_bucket, metadata->>'selectedAssetBucket') || '/' || COALESCE(selected_asset_object_path, metadata->>'selectedAssetObjectPath')
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN latest_asset_bucket IS NOT NULL AND latest_asset_object_path IS NOT NULL THEN '/minio/' || latest_asset_bucket || '/' || latest_asset_object_path
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ),
    'publishedUrl', COALESCE(metadata->>'publishedUrl', metadata->'publishedRecord'->>'publishedUrl'),
    'nextAction', next_action
  ) AS job,
  status,
  updated_at,
  created_at
  FROM job_actions
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*)::int AS count,
    jsonb_agg(job ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC) AS jobs
  FROM job_rows
  GROUP BY status
), counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(status, count), '{}'::jsonb) AS value
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  true AS ok,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'jobs', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(job ORDER BY
      CASE status
        WHEN 'failed' THEN 0
        WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN 1
        WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN 2
        WHEN 'assets-ready' THEN 3
        WHEN 'review-ready' THEN 4
        WHEN 'generating' THEN 5
        WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN 6
        WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN 7
        WHEN 'draft' THEN 8
        ELSE 9
      END,
      updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      created_at DESC
    ) FROM job_rows), '[]'::jsonb),
    'groups', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status', status, 'count', count, 'jobs', jobs) ORDER BY
      CASE status
        WHEN 'failed' THEN 0
        WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN 1
        WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN 2
        WHEN 'assets-ready' THEN 3
        WHEN 'review-ready' THEN 4
        WHEN 'generating' THEN 5
        WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN 6
        WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN 7
        WHEN 'draft' THEN 8
        ELSE 9
      END
    ) FROM grouped), '[]'::jsonb),
    'counts', (SELECT value FROM counts)
  ) AS summary;
`;
return [{ json: { query } }];
